questions.q: Before the 1920s, how did people typically make a phone call?
a: They agreed on a time and shouted into the phone until someone answered
They used a telegraph operator to connect them
They had to visit a central exchange in person
They sent a written message to the recipient first
questions.why: The overview section explains that phones did not make noises until the 1920s, so callers had to coordinate a time and shout.

questions.q: Who is credited with inventing the urinal according to the text?
questions.why: The lesson on forgotten inventors lists Andrew Rankin as the inventor of the urinal.

questions.q: How many Nobel Prize winners came from Bell Labs alumni?
questions.why: The Bell Labs lesson states that among their alumni are 13 Nobel Prize winners and five Turing Award winners.

questions.q: What company did AT&T evolve from?
questions.why: The monopoly lesson explains that AT&T evolved from the Bell Telephone Company, which held Bell's original patent.

questions.q: Who wrote the 2012 book The Idea Factory?
questions.why: The overview identifies Jon Gertner as the author of the 2012 book about Bell Labs.
